# Tauri IPC — invoke calls, Rust commands and type-safe bindings

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-ipc: a Tauri v2 agent skill for frontend-to-Rust IPC with typed invoke calls, Rust commands and type-safe bindings. Trigger phrases (IPC, invoke, command, tauri-specta, type safety, plus Chinese equivalents) route the agent to: define Rust commands and register them in the Tauri builder, invoke them from the frontend with typed payloads, apply type-generation tools (tauri-specta or official generators) to avoid any-typed IPC, and establish error handling and response contracts. Ships with a curated reference list to the official Tauri v2 IPC docs (inter-process communication, calling Rust, calling the frontend). Honest caveats: one of five topic-specific skills from the same repo (an umbrella Tauri router listing is already on the directory); the "gotchas" and Chinese "使用流程" sections are boilerplate shared across the series — the IPC-specific value is the trigger phrases, the how-to steps and the docs reference list. Bilingual EN/中文. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
